verdict.rationale: The CRA runs online e-services (business registration, CRA accounts, EFILE), so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of service. Nothing in the evidence pack covers analytics, cookies, telemetry or any tracking opt-out control. The pack only covers registration, filing and account functions, so the axis applies but the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
